title: Effect of DNA Freezing on Long-Read Sequencing in Butterflies
author: Berenice J. Lafon
materials: We performed one extraction for the abdomen and another for the thorax using the Qiagen Blood & Cell Culture DNA Mini Kit . The abdomen and thorax were ground separately and 1.5 mL of G2 lysis buffer from the Qiagen Blood & Cell Culture DNA Mini Kit was added. Each extraction was performed according to the manufacturer's protocol.

Extraction results and DNA quantity and quality control DNA was quantified using the Qubit‱ 2.0 fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and the NanoDrop‱ spectrophotometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific). DNA quality was also checked by running a 1% agarose gel ( Figure 1 ). After these two extractions we obtained 4 tubes of DNA including: - a DNA pellet for the abdomen (148 ng/µL in 100 µL) - a DNA 'jellyfish' for the abdomen (78.3 ng/µL in 100 µL) - a DNA pellet for the thorax (119 ng/µL in 100 µL) - a DNA 'jellyfish' for the thorax (77.8 ng/µL in 100 µL) Figure 1. Pictured is an agarose gel showing DNA after extraction of the thorax (two left bands) and after extraction of the abdomen (two right bands).

We tested the effect of freezing on the N50 of ONT sequencing (see Figure 2 for the details). To do this, we divided each of the 4 tubes into two (50 µL each), with one tube frozen and the other not. Thus, 4 tubes of DNA were frozen at -20°C for 72 h , while the other 4 tubes were kept in the refrigerator at 4°C for the same period. After freezing and/or refrigeration, we removed fragments smaller than 10 kb from the DNA extracted from the thorax using the Pacific Biosciences Short Read Eliminator (SRE XS), formerly called the "Circulomics" kit, according to the protocol instructions. Figure 2. Illustration of the different treatments applied to extracted DNA for testing the effect of DNA freezing. Blue tubes represent DNA extracted from the abdomen, while red tubes represent DNA extracted from the thorax. Pictured is an adult of the five-bar swordtail ( Graphium antiphates , ‱ Mahesh Baruah) that was used for our study. DNA was quantified using the Qubit‱ 2.0 fluorometer (Thermo Fisher Scientific) and DNA quality was also checked by running a 1% agarose gel.

steps.title: Collect and freeze specimen
steps.instruction: Collect a live Graphium antiphates (FC1341) butterfly, place it alive in a papillote and freeze at –80 °C.

steps.title: Dissect body in ethanol
steps.instruction: Separate the wings, then dissect the butterfly in a Petri dish lined with 96 % ethanol, avoiding bristles or scales; divide the body into abdomen, thorax, and head.

steps.title: Add RNase I and incubate
steps.instruction: Add 3 µL RNase I to each tube and incubate 30 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Add protease, incubate, and centrifuge
steps.instruction: Add 110 µL Protease to each tube, invert periodically, incubate 2 h at 50 °C; then centrifuge at 11,000 rpm for 15 min at 4 °C.

steps.title: Equilibrate columns with QBT
steps.instruction: Add 1 mL QBT buffer to each column and allow the liquid to pass through by gravity.

steps.title: Collect supernatant and add buffer G2
steps.instruction: After centrifugation, transfer the supernatant to a new 2 mL tube, add 400 µL buffer G2, and vortex at medium speed for 10 s.

steps.title: Bind DNA to column and wash
steps.instruction: Transfer the tube to the column, let stand 5–10 min, then wash four times with QC buffer using 1 mL per wash.

steps.title: Elute DNA from column
steps.instruction: Move the column to a new 1.5 mL tube, add 750 µL QF buffer pre‑heated to 50 °C, and elute the DNA.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 525 µL isopropanol, mix by inversion several times; if a DNA ‘jellyfish’ forms, transfer to a tube containing 70 % ethanol, centrifuge 12,000 rpm 5 min, remove all ethanol with a P10 pipette, dry 5 min, and elute in 80 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: Centrifuge DNA solution
steps.instruction: Centrifuge at 12,000 rpm for 20 min at +4 °C.

steps.title: Ethanol wash of DNA pellet
steps.instruction: Remove supernatant, add 1 mL cold 70 % ethanol, mix by inversion, centrifuge 5 min at 12,000 rpm at 4 °C.

steps.title: Repeat ethanol wash
steps.instruction: Repeat the ethanol wash described in the previous step.

steps.title: Remove ethanol and dry
steps.instruction: Remove ethanol with a P10 pipette, then dry the tube for 5 min at room temperature.

steps.title: Final DNA elution
steps.instruction: Elute DNA into 50 µL nuclease‑free water.

steps.title: ONT ligation prep with modifications
steps.instruction: Follow the ONT Genomic DNA by Ligation protocol (SQK‑LSK109) with modifications: incubate 20 min at 20 °C, then 5 min at 65 °C, and place immediately on ice.

steps.title: AMPure bead purification
steps.instruction: Purify using a 1.2× ratio (108 µL Agencourt AMPure XP beads); follow the kit’s purification instructions.

steps.title: Elute purified library
steps.instruction: Elute the purified library in a final volume of 65 µL.

steps.title: Calculate DNA input
steps.instruction: Calculate the volume of DNA needed to obtain approximately 0.2 pmol of DNA per library.

steps.title: Elute into LowBind tube
steps.instruction: Elute the library into a LowBind tube to a final volume of 15 µL.

steps.title: Quantify library with Qubit
steps.instruction: Take 2 µL of the library, measure concentration with Qubit, then add LB and SQB mix to the remaining 13 µL.
